appearances.title: Hermes Agent v0.22.6 adds skill locking and a multi-machine gateway fix
appearances.summary: v0.22.6 adds `hermes curator lock <skill>`, which blocks the agent from changing a skill by any write path, even under --yolo. Locks are per profile; `hermes curator status` lists them and `hermes curator unlock` lifts them. Teknium says the same patch release fixes an issue for multi-machine and gateway users and recommends upgrading.

appearances.title: Hermes migrate will import Grok Bot and OpenBot
appearances.summary: A Hermes Agent pull request, called for the next patch release, adds Grok Bot and OpenBot to first-run setup and to the hermes migrate command. The Grok Bot importer brings routines over as paused cron jobs, along with skills, memories, and role, and hermes migrate <agent> installs the importer plugin when it is missing.

appearances.title: Hermes Webapp is on the main release channel
appearances.summary: Hermes can serve the Desktop workspace from the gateway in a browser on the main channel. It is local-only by default, and remote access is meant to sit behind sign-in. Teknium confirmed the release.

appearances.title: Hermes Agent closes Jensen Huang's GTC Berlin keynote by building a robot training environment
appearances.summary: In NVIDIA's GTC Berlin keynote, a customized open-source Hermes Agent was set up from one prompt on an RTX Spark, then planned an obstacle course with Nemotron, had another model build it with FreeCAD, Omniverse, Blender, Newton and Isaac Lab, and trained simulated Hugging Face Microduck robots until a policy was ready for the real robot.
